meta.prompt: Compare two phone plans side by side. Lite: $25 a month, 10 GB data, 500 minutes of calls, roaming not included, monthly contract, no extras. Max: $45 a month, unlimited data, unlimited calls, roaming in the EU and US, 24-month contract, streaming and 5G included. Mark the better plan on each row (cheaper price, more data, more calls, roaming, shorter contract, more extras). Under the table a recommendation with one sentence that says how many of the six rows the recommended plan wins and how much more it costs per month, and a Choose button under each plan; once I choose, the card says which plan I picked.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Compare phone plans" "Lite vs Max" icon:"compare_arrows" status:"Choose"
  state pick=""
  if pick==""
    ComparisonTable names:["Lite","Max"] prices:["$25/mo","$45/mo"] notes:["10 GB data, 500 min","Unlimited data and calls"] pick:"Lite" rows:[["Price","$25/mo","$45/mo",1],["Data","10 GB","Unlimited","2"],["Calls","500 min","Unlimited","2"],["Roaming","Not included","EU and US",2],["Contract","Monthly","24 months",1],["Extras","None","Streaming and 5G",2]] cta:"Choose" -> pick=result
    Callout "Recommendation" "Max wins 4 of the 6 rows and costs $20 more per month. Lite suits light, home-based use." tone:"accent" icon:"star"
  if pick!=""
    Receipt "Plan chosen" "You picked the {pick} plan." tone:"good" icon:"check"
